reviewer.note: Review at 9366301b (main bytes), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md. All eleven log ends are one stamp (concentric target shading lit at the centre, not the upper left) in a 4-3-4 lattice, and the gaps between them are transparent, so the ground shows through the stack. Sweep cluster-noise rejected as noise: the texture is clean; the fault is repetition and see-through. Fix: three or four log sizes and split halves (flat split face lit, bark arc dark), end grain lit upper left with one ring arc and a radial check, a dark bark rim, the stack packed with a dark back wall (timber 0-1) behind the gaps. Bar 0.69.
